comment: Reviewed SBOM metadata for tools/sbom. Licenses are as declared in each component's own license files, not legal conclusions. A producer is the copyright holder that the component's license file names; an empty producer means none is named, and the SBOM says the producer is unknown. Native and embedded entries apply only while their parent module is linked or their files are embedded; `go run ./tools/sbom check` fails on an entry nothing uses and on anything shipped that has no entry.
